description: The estimation format's registered schemas. Add a profile by pull request: its file under profiles/, at least one example record under examples/, and an entry here (see CONTRIBUTING.md). Everything listed here is CC0-1.0 (LICENSE); contributions must be too. A published entry carries the sha256 of its file and never changes; a fix is a new version.

profiles.name: inference/0.1
profiles.description: Parameters with estimates, standard errors and p-values; a default vcov with type and ssc; nobs and df_residual.

profiles.name: linear-fe/0.1
profiles.description: Linear models with absorbed fixed effects (fixest, lfe, pyfixest, linearmodels, reghdfe, areg, xtreg, FixedEffectModels.jl).

profiles.name: iv/0.1
profiles.description: Instrumental-variables models: endogenous regressors and instruments; first-stage diagnostics expected.

profiles.name: dfeols/0.1
profiles.description: dfeols records: linear-fe plus the dfeols extension block (shards, row key, absorption, demeaning, Dask, replay).

profiles.name: did/0.1
profiles.description: Heterogeneity-robust difference-in-differences and event studies with staggered timing (csdid, R did, did2s, pyfixest did2s): the design, which effect each row is (ATT(g,t), event time, group, calendar, simple), pointwise and uniform bands, cohorts and pre-trend tests.

profiles.name: did2s/0.1
profiles.description: Gardner two-stage DiD records from did2s (Stata, R) and pyfixest: did plus the first- and second-stage specifications, the cluster, and the two-stage GMM (or bootstrap) vcov.

profiles.name: csdid/0.1
profiles.description: Stata csdid records: did plus method, agg and typebase, the influence-function or wild-bootstrap vcov, ATT(g,t) alongside any aggregation, and the e(gtt) cells.

profiles.name: glm/0.1
profiles.description: Generalized linear models with or without absorbed fixed effects (Stata logit/probit/poisson/glm, ppmlhdfe; R glm, fixest feglm/fepois; statsmodels, pyfixest): distribution and link, convergence, log-likelihood, deviance, separation and offsets.

profiles.name: ppmlhdfe/0.1
profiles.description: Stata ppmlhdfe records: glm (Poisson, log) plus separation methods and counts, singletons, absorbed fixed effects, and reghdfe's asymptotic vcov adjustment.

profiles.name: conditional-logit/0.1
profiles.description: Conditional (fixed-effects) logit (Stata clogit, xtlogit fe; R survival::clogit; statsmodels ConditionalLogit): the conditioning groups, exact or approximate likelihood, whether all-0/all-1 groups were dropped, group counts.

profiles.name: mixed/0.1
profiles.description: Linear and generalized linear mixed models (lme4, lmerTest, glmmTMB, Stata mixed/me*, statsmodels MixedLM, MixedModels.jl): REML/ML/quadrature, random-effect terms and grouping factors, variance components with their scale, df method, convergence and singular fits.

profiles.name: choice/0.1
profiles.description: Discrete-choice models (mlogit, logitr, apollo, xlogit, Biogeme, Stata cmclogit/cmmixlogit/mixlogit): choice situations and alternatives, random parameters and simulation draws, preference or WTP space, null and constants-only log-likelihoods, Hessian vs BFGS-approximate vs robust vcov.

profiles.name: sem/0.1
profiles.description: Structural equation models (lavaan, semopy, Stata sem): estimator, model syntax, partable rows (op, lhs, rhs, free) with standardized estimates, chi-square and fit indices, missing-data and likelihood options.

profiles.name: mediation/0.1
profiles.description: Mediation analyses from regressions or SEM (R mediation, lavaan :=, PROCESS, Stata sem estat teffects, pingouin, statsmodels Mediation): treatment, mediators, outcome, the inference method (bootstrap, quasi-Bayesian, delta) with replications and CI type, and which effect each row is.
